defaults.prerequisites: Place a valid breakdown.workflow.v1 Workflow Definition and its declared Input files in a real temporary local project.
defaults.action: Call create_run through the core dispatcher with the temporary project as the explicit trusted project root.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: create a complete immutable Run through create_run
rows.oracle: One new outputs/<run-id> contains exact run.md and breakdown.yaml bytes plus an empty steps directory.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: resolve each Workflow Input from one override or default
rows.oracle: The Run Manifest contains exactly every declared Input, ordered by identifier, with its selected portable path.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: hash exact raw Workflow Definition and Input bytes
rows.oracle: Frozen SHA-256 byte vectors match the Workflow Snapshot and every resolved Input.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: reject missing, unknown, conflicting, or unsafe Input paths
rows.oracle: Creation fails before publication with structured ordered diagnostics and no visible Run.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: reject linked, special, aliased, replaced, or mutated Inputs
rows.oracle: Secure no-follow reads fail closed and no visible partial Run is published.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: enforce per-Input and aggregate Input byte limits without truncation
rows.oracle: Limit minus one and limit succeed; limit plus one fails resource_limit/limit_exceeded without publication.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: publish Run history atomically without replacement
rows.oracle: Injected faults before directory commit leave no visible Run; a committed Run is complete and final paths are never overwritten.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: keep prior Workflow Snapshots immutable when the live definition changes
rows.oracle: A live edit affects only a later Run; each Run retains its selected exact bytes and digest.

rows.requirement: Issue #146: create private Breakdown-owned files and directories
rows.oracle: On POSIX, new Run directories are 0700 and run.md plus breakdown.yaml are 0600.
